notes.text: Floor 1 took 6 turns, the Drone came last of 6 rooms. Pocket Dynamo: stat pool stayed 0/0 after Red played it alone and gained +1/+1 once Gray played (5/5 after both). Red's reward offer shows Junk Launcher twice in one spread of 3; is a duplicate pick meant to be possible?

Floor 2 turns 7-10: four Security Turnstile rooms in a row, each cleared on Scramble 3 by Gray alone (Coil Of Cable, Pick The Lock, Battery into Distract & Pivot). Red held the same five cards (3 Charge In, Overdrive, Pocket Dynamo) all four turns and played nothing. Not a problem, but the turns have no decisions for Red.

Band 1 over in 15 turns (floor 1: 6, floor 2: 5, floor 3: 4), zero Exhaust on either side, no Flee. Second reward spread with a duplicate in it (Brute Recycle twice for Red, Junk Launcher twice earlier). Red has played 5 cards in 15 turns.
Correction to the previous note: Red played about 11 cards in Band 1, not 5. I miscounted.

Band 2 done in 10 turns (16-25), no Flee, Exhaust 1 total (my own Reckless Swing, which took Red's Pry Bar off the deck). Floor 6 lasted one turn, the Gears & Glitch stairwell came first. Entering Band 3 with Red ~33 cards, Gray ~32.

Laser Grid Security Hall, floor 7 first room. Scramble 14: Gray tops out near 8 (Coil 3, Distract & Pivot 3, five-card hand) and Red has 3, so about 11 at best. Oomph 18: Red about 10 (Overdrive, Fast Follow, Torch), Gray about 5, so 15 at best. Neither is reachable, so I Flee (Exhaust 4 each) and keep both hands for the next room.

Iron Sentinel, floor 7. I worked through every card in both hands. 10/10 tops out at Oomph 10, Scramble 9: Gray Coil and Distract & Pivot (paying Duck Under x2) give S6, Red Duct Tape free via the discount plus Lean In give S3, and Oomph 10 comes from Fast Follow, Overdrive and the rest. One Scramble short. Oomph 18 tops out near 15. Fleeing costs Exhaust 4 each plus Bad Stuff each, on top of the Laser Grid Flee I just took. Deciding to Flee again because the alternative is no clear at all.

Paying for cards with Panic and Sluggish cleaned both out for free: Sluggish paid Gray's Torch, Panic paid Red's Torch, and the Vault cleared on Oomph 15 with no Panic penalty left. Panic also turned the Vault's 'Oomph 15' into 'Oomph 15 and Scramble 2 (printed 0)', so its +2 applies even to a threshold that prints no Scramble. Reads right against the card text. Bad Stuff is a payer, so it costs a turn's payment slots, not a Flee.

Iron Sentinel 10/10 on the second visit. Found by a brute-force over the two hands (my own scratch script, not the engine): Red Coil and Charge In first, Gray Duct Tape, Battery into a free Distract & Pivot, then Red's Riot Shield at cost 0 from the discount. Order was the whole solution, as in earlier runs.

Iron Sentinel on floor 8 looked unreachable by hand (S8 max) until Gray's Hack the Doors showed Red's top 3 (Tag Team, Cross Punch, Set 'Em Up). I set Tag Team on top, then Rhythm & Bruise (Gray had played 2) drew it, and Tag Team made up the last Oomph 2 / Scramble 2. Exactly 10/10. Peek plus a draw engine decided the turn; it was the only way to clear, else Flee.

Iron Sentinel again, first room of floor 9 (third floor in a row where it came up first or second). Searched both hands exhaustively for 10/10 or Oomph 18 with my scratch script: no line reaches either, and nothing in hand draws or peeks. Fleeing. Exhaust 4 each will take Red's whole deck (4 cards) and Bad Stuff goes into both hands.

Iron Sentinel, last card of floor 9, so a Flee would have looped it straight back. By hand it topped out at 10/9. Stim Pack's draw gave a Coil Of Cable, and with both Coils, Riot Shield paid by the Bad Stuff Quantum Spinning, and Rhythm & Bruise counting Gray's two plays, it cleared at 10/12. Again a card draw decided a turn the fixed hand could not.

Monolith Core, my mistake: I searched with a script, found (8,11) and (10,8) lines that needed a couple of points from Covering Fire draws, then spent both Second Winds as payers for Riot Shield and Shove to trigger two draws. That left Red with an empty hand and the pool at Oomph 4 / Scramble 5 with only 5 more Oomph in Gray's hand (Duct, Battery, Quick Vault). Oomph 9 maximum, so the win is one short. Not a rules issue. Fleeing (Exhaust 5 each) and keeping Gray's six-card hand for the next try.

Monolith Core cleared at exactly 10/10 on the second try: Red Charge In paid with Shove and Tag Team, Overdrive (Exhaust 2 no longer matters on the last turn), Gray Duct Tape paid by Pick The Lock, Battery paid by Quick Vault into a free In Step counting Red's two plays (4), and Coil. Panic left Red's hand a turn ago, which dropped Scramble back to 10. Found with a scratch script again; by hand I would not have seen it.
